data.providerPathway: Michigan's official counselor CE provider-acceptance and approval pathway could not be verified from the official sources located; therefore NBCC ACEP equivalence is unresolved.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved from the official sources located: no verified counselor-specific rule stating whether self-paced/home-study is creditable or how it is measured.
data.limits: Unresolved; no verified counselor-specific asynchronous cap or hour conversion located.
data.passage: No sufficiently specific official passage was located establishing the counselor provider pathway or asynchronous/home-study treatment. This is marked unresolved, not prohibited.

data.providerPathway: Michigan's official marriage-and-family-therapy CE provider pathway could not be verified from the official sources located; NBCC ACEP equivalence is unresolved.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved from the official sources located: no verified LMFT-specific rule on self-paced/home-study CE.
data.limits: Unresolved; no verified LMFT asynchronous cap or conversion located.
data.passage: No sufficiently specific official passage was located establishing the LMFT provider pathway or asynchronous/home-study treatment. This is marked unresolved, not prohibited.

data.providerPathway: Board-approved courses/programs are required. The official Michigan social-work brochure does not say NBCC ACEP itself qualifies; ACEP qualification is therefore unresolved unless the course/program is also Board-approved or otherwise accepted under the rule.
data.asyncRule: Self-paced/online is conditionally usable: at least one-half of required CE must be in person using live, synchronous contact; the remainder may use another approved format.
data.limits: 45 hours per 3-year renewal period; at least 5 ethics and 2 pain-management hours. Practical asynchronous ceiling is up to the remaining half (22.5 hours), subject to approval; the official passage does not specify a different conversion for self-paced hours.
data.passage: “every licensed Master’s and Bachelor’s social worker [must] complete…at least 45 hours of continuing education in courses or programs approved by the Board” (p. 1); “one half of the required continuing education contact hours must be completed in person using live, synchronous contact. The remaining continuing education contact hours may be completed in any other approved format” (p. 1); “at least five…hours in ethics and at least two hours in pain management” (p. 1).

data.providerPathway: The Minnesota Board states CE must be counseling-related and requires evidence satisfactory to the Board, but the official page located does not establish that NBCC ACEP is an accepted provider pathway or equivalent.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved: the official LPC/LPCC CE page located does not state whether self-paced/home-study counts, nor a full-hour rule.
data.limits: 40 continuing-education hours every two years after the fourth renewal period; no verified asynchronous cap/conversion in the located official passage.
data.passage: Minnesota Board: “all Licensed Professional Counselors and Licensed Professional Clinical Counselors are required to complete continuing educations units every two years. All continuing education must be counseling-related in nature”; after the fourth renewal period, licensees “must present evidence satisfactory to the Board of completion of 40 continuing education hours.”

data.providerPathway: A program sponsor may obtain Minnesota Board of MFT approval (approved programs receive a Board-issued CE approval number), or the licensee may submit an LMFT Application for CE Course Approval. The official source does not recognize NBCC ACEP as a substitute provider pathway.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved whether a self-paced/home-study course is acceptable as such; the official page says the certificate hours or actual attendance, whichever is less, may count, but does not define asynchronous attendance or conversion.
data.limits: 40 hours every two years, including 3 ethics and 4 cultural-competency hours; supervisor status adds 4 supervision hours. Count is the certificate hours or actual attendance, whichever is less.
data.passage: Board page: “If already approved, program will be listed on Board’s website and program sponsor will have a Board-Issued CE approval number”; if not, “submit an LMFT Application for CE Course Approval”; and “The number of hours reflected on the certification…or the number of hours of actual attendance (whichever is less), may be counted as CE.”

data.providerPathway: The official Minnesota social-work page located describes documentation/audit rather than a provider-approval pathway; NBCC ACEP acceptance is unresolved.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved: the located official page lists workshops, seminars, conferences, and live webinars but does not establish self-paced/home-study credit treatment.
data.limits: Unresolved from the located official passage; no verified asynchronous cap or conversion.
data.passage: Minnesota Board page requires licensees to “Keep acceptable forms of CE documentation…for one year following your renewal date” and its listed documentation includes “Educational workshops, seminars, conferences, or live webinars.” It does not state that NBCC ACEP is accepted or address self-paced/home-study counting.

data.providerPathway: Mississippi LPC Board pre-approves providers/activities; the rule expressly lists NBCC provider numbers among qualifying study options, so NBCC ACEP is a qualifying provider pathway (subject to the course fitting Board content/record rules).
data.asyncRule: Self-study options are expressly recognized; asynchronous/home-study is not prohibited in the cited rule.
data.limits: 24 CEH per license period (six ethics CEH); one CEH is a clock hour. The cited provisions do not state a separate asynchronous cap or conversion.
data.passage: Rule 6.1/6.2: ‘twenty-four (24) Continuing Education Hours during the preceding license period’; ‘Clock Hours ...’; Rule 6.2.C lists pre-approved providers and says study options ‘must carry a provider number from either NBCC, or other [listed]’; it also provides that non-pre-approved providers may be approved by the Board.

data.providerPathway: Only programs/activities approved by the Mississippi MFT Continuing Education Committee qualify; NBCC ACEP is not stated to be automatically accepted, so it requires Mississippi Committee approval (or approved-provider/individual application).
data.asyncRule: Asynchronous/distance/internet learning may count generally, but not for the required MFT ethics CE or supervision CE: the Board ‘will not approve’ self-directed or distance/internet courses for those components.
data.limits: 24 approved hours per two-year period, including 4 MFT professional-ethics hours; 2 supervision CE hours for approved supervisors. Approved offerings ordinarily receive one clock-hour credit per clock-hour spent.
data.passage: Rule 4.1.B: ‘Credit will be given only for continuing education programs or activities approved by the MFT Continuing Education Committee’; ‘Four (4) out of the 24 must be approved MFT professional ethics hours’; ‘The Board will not approve self-directed learning projects and/or distance learning/internet (online) learning courses for the MFT ethics CE requirement’; same prohibition for supervision CE. Rule 4.1.D: ‘one continuing education clock-hour credit for each one clock-hour spent.’

data.providerPathway: Mississippi Board of Examiners for Social Workers and MFTs uses Board Designated Provider approval and individually approved activities. The materials identify automatically approved organizations, but do not identify NBCC ACEP; therefore NBCC ACEP requires confirmation/individual approval rather than being established as automatic.
data.asyncRule: Distance education, including home study, is an accepted provider/course format when the Board’s distance-education standards are met (online verification, tests/evaluation and instructional materials).
data.limits: 30 CE clock hours per renewal cycle; 3 ethics and 2 suicide-assessment hours are specified. The cited provider guide does not state a numeric cap or conversion for asynchronous hours.
data.passage: Provider guide: ‘The MBOESW MFT sees the approval of continuing education providers’; ‘The following organizations are automatically approved’; ‘Distance education includes home study’; online courses require ‘instructions, test user account ... pre and/or post-tests, and evaluation.’ It states the provider must show ‘____ continuing education clock hours.’

data.providerPathway: Missouri requires formal CE from an acceptable education institution/provider or qualifying professional meeting rule criteria; the cited rule does not name NBCC ACEP as automatically accepted. Treat NBCC ACEP as conditional on fitting the formal-CE/acceptable-provider definition.
data.asyncRule: Self-study is expressly allowed, so asynchronous/home-study can count as self-study; formal asynchronous treatment is not resolved by this rule.
data.limits: 40 hours per renewal: at least 20 formal and no more than 20 self-study. CE hour is 50 minutes of instruction or study; each self-study hour is therefore credited under that definition, not necessarily each advertised 60-minute hour.
data.passage: 20 CSR 2095-1.064(2),(4): ‘an hour ... fifty (50) minutes of instruction or study’; ‘forty (40) hours ... at least twenty (20) hours of formal ... and not more than twenty (20) hours of self study.’

data.providerPathway: Missouri’s official LMFT materials were located, but the retrieved current rule text does not provide enough CE provider-pathway language to establish NBCC ACEP acceptance or rejection.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved from the retrieved official rule text; no reliable official passage located establishing whether self-paced/home-study counts.
data.limits: Unresolved for asynchronous caps/conversions from the retrieved official sources.
data.passage: The official Secretary of State LMFT rule source is the governing source, but the retrieved text concerns licensure/other requirements and does not supply a CE provider or asynchronous-credit rule; therefore no conclusion is drawn from absence.

data.providerPathway: Missouri social-work rule requires ‘acceptable continuing professional education courses’ but the retrieved rule does not name NBCC ACEP or create a general NBCC provider pathway; NBCC ACEP is conditional on the course/provider meeting Missouri acceptability requirements.
data.asyncRule: The retrieved official rule defines acceptable CE as a formal curriculum of learning but does not expressly resolve self-paced/home-study delivery; asynchronous treatment is unresolved rather than prohibited.
data.limits: 30 clock hours per renewal; 3 ethics hours and 2 suicide-assessment/referral/treatment/management hours. No asynchronous cap or conversion is stated in the retrieved rule.
data.passage: 20 CSR 2263-2.082(1)-(2): ‘thirty (30) clock hours of acceptable continuing professional education courses’; includes ‘Three (3) clock hours of ethics’ and ‘Two (2) hours of suicide assessment...’; (4): acceptable activity is ‘a formal curriculum of learning’.

data.providerPathway: Montana Board of Behavioral Health regulates LCPC and LMFT; the official material located does not identify NBCC ACEP or an equivalent provider-approval pathway for counselor CE.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved from the official sources located; no official board passage confirming or rejecting self-paced/home-study CE was found.
data.limits: Unresolved; do not infer a cap or prohibition from the absence of a rule in the located material.
data.passage: Official Board page identifies the Board of Behavioral Health and its regulated credentials as ‘Licensed clinical professional counselor (LCPC)’ and ‘Licensed marriage and family therapist (LMFT).’ The located official pages did not contain a provider pathway or asynchronous-hour rule sufficient to decide NBCC ACEP acceptance. Montana MCA §37-1-306 provides only the general authority that ‘A board may require licensees to participate in flexible, cost-efficient, effective, and geographically accessible continuing education’; it does not resolve provider acceptance or hour counting.

data.providerPathway: No official source located that expressly accepts NBCC ACEP or states the Board’s equivalent provider pathway for LMFT CE.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved from official sources located.
data.limits: Unresolved; no official cap/conversion located.
data.passage: The official Board page lists ‘Licensed marriage and family therapist (LMFT)’ under the Board’s jurisdiction. MCA §37-1-306 says a board may require participation in ‘flexible, cost-efficient, effective, and geographically accessible continuing education,’ but the located official text does not say which providers qualify or how asynchronous hours are counted.

data.providerPathway: No official source located that expressly accepts ASWB/NBCC ACEP or identifies an equivalent provider pathway for Montana LCSW CE.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved from official sources located.
data.limits: Unresolved; no official cap/conversion located.
data.passage: The official Board page describes the Board of Behavioral Health as protecting ‘professional counseling, social work, marriage and family therapy.’ The official statute located authorizes flexible/geographically accessible CE but does not establish a provider list or asynchronous counting rule; therefore acceptance is unresolved.

data.providerPathway: CE must be acceptable under Title 172, Chapter 94; the rule does not name NBCC ACEP in the relevant CE provision, so NBCC ACEP is not expressly confirmed from this source and should be treated as conditional pending Department confirmation.
data.asyncRule: Home-study, video, and electronically transmitted programs are expressly acceptable; hours are determined by the program provider, so advertised hours can count as determined by that provider.
data.limits: 32 acceptable CE hours per 24-month renewal period, including 4 ethics hours; for independent practitioners, 6 hours on diagnosis/treatment of major mental disorders.
data.passage: 172 NAC 94-012: ‘During the 24 months prior to the renewal date…must complete at least 32 hours of acceptable continuing education hours related to mental health practice’; ‘All license and certificate holders must complete at least 4 hours…in ethics’; and ‘Hours for completing home study or video programs, including those transmitted through electronic means, are determined by the provider of the program.’ The chapter title expressly covers ‘Independent Mental Health Practitioners, Mental Health Practitioners, Marriage and Family Therapists, Professional Counselors, and Social Workers.’

data.providerPathway: Title 172, Chapter 94’s acceptable-CE framework applies to marriage and family therapists; NBCC ACEP is not expressly named in the located rule, so qualification is conditional rather than confirmed.
data.asyncRule: Home study/video/electronic programs count, with hours determined by the provider; no separate asynchronous cap appears in §012.03(D).
data.limits: At least 32 acceptable CE hours in each 24-month period; at least 4 ethics hours. The rule also states 60 minutes equals 1 CE hour for workshops, lectures, or interactive webinars.
data.passage: The official rule’s title covers ‘Marriage and Family Therapists.’ Section 012 requires ‘at least 32 hours of acceptable continuing education’ in the preceding 24 months; §012.01(A) requires ‘at least 4 hours…in ethics’; and §012.03(D) says ‘Hours for completing home study or video programs, including those transmitted through electronic means, are determined by the provider of the program.’

data.providerPathway: Title 172, Chapter 94 covers social workers and requires acceptable CE, but the located official rule does not expressly name ASWB ACE/NBCC ACEP; provider qualification is therefore conditional.
data.asyncRule: Self-paced/home-study, video, and electronic programs are expressly recognized; the provider determines the hours, with no stated home-study cap in §012.03(D).
data.limits: At least 32 acceptable CE hours per 24-month renewal period and at least 4 ethics hours; no separate asynchronous conversion/cap stated in the cited provision.
data.passage: The chapter title includes ‘Social Workers.’ Section 012 requires ‘at least 32 hours of acceptable continuing education hours’ during the 24 months before renewal; §012.01(A) requires ‘at least 4 hours…in ethics’; and §012.03(D) provides: ‘Hours for completing home study or video programs, including those transmitted through electronic means, are determined by the provider of the program.’

data.providerPathway: Nevada NAC 641A allows a provider to apply for Board-approved-provider status; the cited rule does not name NBCC ACEP, so ACEP acceptance is conditional on Nevada Board approval/recognition of the provider or program.
data.asyncRule: Asynchronous/noninteractive distance education is allowed.
data.limits: No more than 20 hours of noninteractive distance education may be used toward the renewal requirement; the rule defines distance education as education delivered to a student geographically separate from the instructor. Thus advertised asynchronous hours count only up to the 20-hour cap (subject to documentation and the Board's approval rules).
data.passage: NAC 641A.131(4): “A marriage and family therapist or clinical professional counselor shall not use more than 20 hours of distance education that is not interactive to satisfy” the CE requirement. NAC 641A.131(9): “distance education” means education, training, courses or programs “delivered to a student who is geographically separate from the instructor.” NAC 641A.126 is titled “Approved provider of continuing education: Application; qualifications...” and sets the Board-approval pathway.

data.providerPathway: Nevada NAC 641A provides a Board-approved-provider pathway; it does not expressly identify NBCC ACEP. An NBCC ACEP provider therefore requires confirmation that the provider/program meets Nevada Board approval requirements.
data.asyncRule: Asynchronous/noninteractive distance education is permitted.
data.limits: Maximum 20 hours of noninteractive distance education toward the applicable renewal CE requirement; remaining hours must be satisfied through otherwise acceptable/approved CE. Documentation is required.
data.passage: NAC 641A.131(4): “A marriage and family therapist or clinical professional counselor shall not use more than 20 hours of distance education that is not interactive.” NAC 641A.131(9) defines distance education as programs delivered while the student is geographically separate from the instructor. NAC 641A.126 establishes application and qualifications for an approved provider of continuing education.

data.providerPathway: NAC 641B requires Board approval of CE programs, but deems programs approved by NASW or ASWB approved. NBCC ACEP is not named in the cited rule; acceptance is therefore conditional unless the specific program/provider separately has Nevada Board approval (or another listed deemed-approval basis).
data.asyncRule: Online learning courses, including asynchronous courses, are an expressly acceptable program form if they meet the rule's completion-verification requirements.
data.limits: No numeric asynchronous cap is stated in NAC 641B.189. An online course must require an examination and independent verification of successful completion; hours are the hours approved by the Board/program approval. LCSW requires at least 36 CE hours per reporting period, including 4 ethics and 2 suicide-prevention hours.
data.passage: NAC 641B.189(1): a program may be “online learning courses.” NAC 641B.189(3): a course/program approved by “the National Association for Social Workers or the Association of Social Work Boards shall be deemed approved.” NAC 641B.189(4)(d): an online course is unacceptable if it does not require an examination and independent verification of successful completion. NAC 641B.187(1)(b) requires an LCSW to complete “at least 36 hours” per reporting period.

data.providerPathway: New Hampshire Mhp 402.04(b) requires Category A CE (including online/home study) to be provided by a state, regional, national, or international professional association offering relevant mental-health-practice education. NBCC is a national professional association; on the text available, an NBCC ACEP provider fits this broad pathway, subject to relevance/documentation.
data.asyncRule: Home study and online CE are expressly recognized under Category A.
data.limits: Clinical mental health counselors may use up to 30 home-study CE hours; the overall requirement is 40 hours every 2 years, at least 30 Category A, including at least 6 ethics and 3 suicide-prevention hours. The rule does not state a conversion discount for advertised home-study hours.
data.passage: Mhp 402.01(a)-(e): “40 hours of approved continuing education (CE) every 2 years”; at least 30 Category A, at least 6 ethics, at least 3 suicide prevention, and no more than 10 Category B. Mhp 402.04(a)(2)(a): home study is limited to “Up to a maximum of 30 CE hours” for licensed independent clinical social workers, clinical mental health counselors, and marriage and family therapists. Mhp 402.04(b): “Category A seminars, workshops, on-line, home study, or other CE shall be provided by a state, regional, national, or international professional association offering education relevant to the mental health practice.”

data.providerPathway: Mhp 402.04(b) accepts Category A online/home-study CE when provided by a state, regional, national, or international professional association offering relevant mental-health-practice education. NBCC ACEP may fit the broad national-association category, but is not expressly named, subject to relevance and records.
data.asyncRule: Online and home-study CE are expressly allowed as Category A.
data.limits: Home study is capped at 30 CE hours for marriage and family therapists. Total is 40 hours/2 years, with at least 30 Category A, 6 ethics, and 3 suicide prevention; no separate hour conversion is specified.
data.passage: Mhp 402.04(a)(2)(a): home study is limited to “Up to a maximum of 30 CE hours” for ... marriage and family therapists. Mhp 402.04(b): “Category A seminars, workshops, on-line, home study, or other CE shall be provided by a state, regional, national, or international professional association offering education relevant to the mental health practice.” Mhp 402.01 requires 40 hours every 2 years, with 30 Category A, 6 ethics, and 3 suicide prevention.

data.providerPathway: Mhp 402.04(b) provides the same national-professional-association pathway for Category A online/home-study CE. NBCC ACEP may fit the broad national-association category, but is not expressly named, but the course must be relevant and documented.
data.asyncRule: Online and home-study CE are expressly recognized as Category A methods.
data.limits: For a licensed independent clinical social worker, home study is capped at 30 CE hours. Total is 40 hours every 2 years, at least 30 Category A, including 6 ethics and 3 suicide prevention; no conversion factor is stated.
data.passage: Mhp 402.04(a)(2)(a): home study is limited to “Up to a maximum of 30 CE hours” for licensed independent clinical social workers. Mhp 402.04(b): Category A “on-line, home study, or other CE shall be provided by a state, regional, national, or international professional association” offering relevant education. Mhp 402.01 requires 40 CE hours every 2 years, at least 30 Category A, 6 ethics, and 3 suicide prevention.

data.providerPathway: New Jersey requires CE through the approved continuing-education course/program provider pathway in N.J.A.C. 13:34-15; the official FAQ says the Committee does not approve individual courses, but the retrieved passage does not identify NBCC ACEP, so NBCC acceptance is unresolved.
data.asyncRule: Online CE is expressly permitted by the Committee.
data.limits: 40 CEUs per biennium; 5 ethics and 3 social/cultural competency; up to 10 excess CEUs may carry forward. No official cap or hour-conversion rule for self-paced/home-study was located.
data.passage: "40 CEU's are required every two (2) years pursuant to N.J.A.C. 13:34-15.1. Five (5) CEU's must be in ethics and three (3) must be in social and cultural competency... Refer to N.J.A.C. 13:34-15 for a list of approved continuing education course/program providers." "Can I complete my CEU's online? Yes, CEU's may be completed online." "The Committee itself does not approve continuing education courses or programs."

data.providerPathway: Official NJ Board materials located did not provide enough accessible text to identify the current approved-provider pathway or establish that NBCC ACEP is accepted for LMFTs.
data.asyncRule: Unresolved from the official sources retrieved; do not infer a prohibition.
data.limits: Unresolved; no reliable official passage retrieved establishing a home-study/asynchronous cap or conversion.
data.passage: The official MFT FAQ retrieved contained complaint information but no usable CE provider or asynchronous rule passage; the official rule-adoption document is supplied for further rule verification.

data.providerPathway: Each course must be approved in advance by a formally recognized entity; the Board identifies ASWB as an authorized CE approval entity. NBCC ACEP is not expressly identified in the official NJ social-work passage, so NBCC acceptance is unresolved unless the particular course/provider also has recognized approval.
data.asyncRule: No official NJ social-work passage retrieved addressing online, self-paced, home-study, or asynchronous delivery; unresolved, not prohibited.
data.limits: No official asynchronous cap or hour conversion located. Board page notes at least one opioid-drug CE credit per licensing cycle.
data.passage: "Organizations that offer continuing education in New Jersey must have each course approved in advance by a formally recognized entity, such as the Association of Social Work Boards (ASWB). ASWB is an authorized continuing education approval entity of the New Jersey Board of Social Work Examiners."

data.providerPathway: The Counseling and Therapy Practice Board accepts CE approved by NBCC and other listed mental-health associations/boards; this is a broad equivalent provider pathway that includes NBCC (and therefore supports NBCC ACEP as the provider route).
data.asyncRule: The Board's current page says there are no longer requirements on how to obtain CEUs and licensees may obtain them however they like; it does not expressly say self-paced/home-study hours are counted at advertised hours.
data.limits: 40 CE hours per two-year renewal period, including 12 ethics hours. No explicit asynchronous cap or conversion in the retrieved official passage.
data.passage: "all registered and licensed professionals will be required to submit proof of 40 hours of continuing education... There are no longer requirements on how to get Continuing Education Units (CEUs); licensees may obtain them however they would like. All licensees must obtain 12 CEU hours of ethics." Rule 16.27.16.9(A): courses "approved by local, state, national, or international mental health-related professional associations such as the National Board for Certified Counselors".

data.providerPathway: Same New Mexico Counseling and Therapy Practice Board pathway: CE approved by NBCC or other listed mental-health professional associations/related regulatory boards is acceptable.
data.asyncRule: No delivery-method restriction is stated on the official current page; it says licensees may obtain CEUs however they would like. Whether an advertised self-paced course hour is automatically one CE hour is not expressly stated.
data.limits: 40 CE hours per two-year renewal period; 12 ethics hours. No explicit asynchronous cap/conversion located.
data.passage: "There are no longer requirements on how to get Continuing Education Units (CEUs); licensees may obtain them however they would like." 16.27.16.9(A) lists courses approved by associations "such as the National Board for Certified Counselors".

data.providerPathway: The NM Social Work Examiners Board accepts CEUs approved by NASW, ASWB, NBCC, the NM Counseling and Therapy Board, and the NM Psychology Board; its official FAQ also directs prospective providers to contact those organizations to apply as CEU providers. NBCC ACEP is expressly within the accepted pathway.
data.asyncRule: Official FAQ does not specify whether self-paced/home-study or asynchronous CE is counted at full advertised hours; unresolved on that detail.
data.limits: 30 CE hours every two years; 6 cultural awareness and 3 professional ethics; 23 of 30 must be board approved. No asynchronous cap/conversion stated in the retrieved official FAQ.
data.passage: "You will need to complete a total of 30 continuing education (CE) hours every two years... 6 must be in the area of cultural awareness, and 3... professional ethics... 23 CEU's will need to be board approved." "The board accepts all CEUs approved by NASW, ASWB, NBCC, NM Counseling and Therapy Board, and the NM Psychology Board." "How do I become a continuing education provider? You can contact NASW, ASWB, NBCC... to apply as a CEU Provider."
